brief: Goldman Sachs equity sales note, 4 Sep 2026. Waller corroborated Williams that the committee center has not shifted materially and remains data dependent, and signalled he might hold in September unless inflation comes in hot and that NFP matters less than CPI, so event risk migrates from payrolls to CPI. Payroll consensus is only about +55k, the hurdle is low, and the author flags downside risk on NFP alongside a seasonal tendency for weak August first prints. On AI, Astra lifted SoftBank 10-11% and Oracle 5.5% overnight. The author argues a frontier step-change forces competitors to chase and keeps the spending cycle alive, says he is not bearish AI while acknowledging hardware de-rating, and sees a constructive September AI calendar. In Japan, a strengthening yen with no obvious intervention, BOJ pricing of just over 25bps for September and near 100bps over a year, and Takaichi FY27 budget requests of Y143.1tn combine loose fiscal with tight money. Exporters should struggle, domestic banks should trade better, and the carry trade hit is slightly punitive for risk. Energy stays the biggest unresolved risk with Hormuz impaired. Lighter positioning plus the AI calendar give melt-up ingredients, with energy and CPI the spoilers.
